svg.title: Triad Court: a map for 3 kings and their peasants
svg.desc: The three kings share one walled citadel in the middle, each in its own third, with a door out to its peasants and a door in to the council chamber, where the treasury's metal lies. Ridges divide the peasants' realms; the ring road round the walls is the only way between them for vehicles.
svg.text: 3 kings, 3 peasants each · 20 × 20 map (10240 game units square) · 3 teams of 4, 12 players
The three kings share one walled citadel in the middle, each in its own third, with a door out to its
peasants and a door in to the council chamber, where the treasury's metal lies. Ridges divide the
peasants' realms; the ring road round the walls is the only way between them for vehicles.
Planet Relic · a graveyard of old armies
Ground: grey-beige dust over old scorched craters, darker scorch marks, worn flagstones inside the
Plants: a few stunted treetype firs in the realms; grass only in the council chamber.
Features: wrecks everywhere to reclaim: armfus_dead, armgate_dead and corbats_dead hulks in the
realms; armstone, corstone and legstone tombstones in the citadel; rocks30_map along the ridges.
Sky and weather: overcast grey sky, dust haze; wind 6 to 16; tidal 0.
Each third is the same, turned 120° about the centre. Heights in game units; lighter ground stands higher.
